desc: 高腰直筒垂坠、裸感针织亲肤，从训练室一路穿到街角
leaf: 女式高腰直筒裸感健身长裤
name: 高腰直筒裸感垂坠健身长裤款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一秒赢得点击，用无底纹纯白构图交代高腰头与直筒垂坠廓形。
承接主图，用深色底逆光轮廓一秒传达垂坠不贴身这一核心利益。
让买家把自己代入日间街拍通勤，确认这条裤子离开健身房也成立。
夜间街拍的低角度放大裤腿长度与堆量，补足第二种穿法想象。
用正后背走线证明版型与做工，回应会不会卡裆起褶的疑虑。
以极特写交代腰头折边与包缝走线，用真实织纹支撑品质感。
把三条版型与面料主张压进编号引线栏，一眼讲清结构卖点。
shots.textZone: 左侧 42% 三条编号引线标注位

shots.intent: 以空参数栏与空心证框收口，留出可核验的信任位而不编造资质。
shots.textZone: 左半空参数栏与两枚空心印章框位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF sweep reserved for the platform packshot, asphalt fields #3A3E42 and slate #4A4F52 for silhouette and macro frames, bone-white info panel #F4F6F5 for the callout screen, real sidewalk and damp night curb for the two lifestyle frames, one material per shot
style.direction: cool technical athleisure commerce with an asphalt-and-moss street edge
style.iconSystem: hairline single-weight line only: numbered index chips, leader rules and empty stamp frames in #A9D74A, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: cool daylight-balanced 5600K studio key from large softboxes with bounce fill, low contrast, one soft contact shadow that always grounds the hem, skimming light only on the seam macro, one hard moss-tinted rim on the rear silhouette frame
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool technical athleisure commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bone-white info field #F4F6F5, asphalt grey #3A3E42, ink-charcoal text #1E2124 and one acid moss accent #A9D74A, with a seamless pure white #FFFFFF ground reserved for the platform packshot; cool daylight-balanced studio light at 5600K from large softboxes with bounce fill and one soft contact shadow that always grounds the hem; one modern geometric sans-serif; hairline single-weight line icons only, numbered chips, leader rules and empty stamp frames; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; matte bare-feel technical knit with true drape and a straight floor-breaking hem, never glossy or shrink-wrapped; figure cropped from the collarbone or ribs down with no face; stable silhouette scale and leg column; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy latex fabric, no visible face or model likeness.
noDrift: no glossy or shrink-wrapped fabric rendering
no visible face or model likeness
style.presentationRules: figure always cropped from the collarbone or ribs down so no face appears, stable straight-on or 45-degree rear silhouette scale, straight leg column and hem break readable in every frame, hand only when it stays clear of the waistband
style.surfaceSystem: matte bare-feel technical knit with true drape and a straight floor-breaking hem, set against pale stone, concrete paving and damp asphalt grounds; no gloss and no latex sheen anywhere
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif, labels set as short numbered callouts on hairline leader rules, never dense body copy
